verdict: Qcycle can be constructed canonically on a shortest noncontractible projective geodesic gamma in unit round RP3. In the integral bases e0=1 and e1=ds/pi, the Hodge L2 Gram matrix is diag(pi,pi^-1). Its determinant is one and the unique primitive self-dual lattice vector v=(1,1) has squared norm pi+pi^-1. This derives the desired reciprocal factor without using a branch-dependent holonomy angle. The remaining gap is physical rather than algebraic: derive the ambient-spinor restriction and EFT vertex that insert Qcycle^(1/2) into m_D.
